title: Remove the first IT company
description:
Remove the first IT company from the list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as remove_first_company(companies), returning a new list without the first item.
hints: Slicing can skip over the first item of a list.
Starting a slice at index 1 leaves out index 0.
expected_behavior: Returns a new list with the first item removed.
explanation: companies[1:] slices from index 1 to the end, dropping the first item.
